name: com.gameframex.unity.payment.apple
description:
GameFrameX Payment Apple — Apple App Store in-app purchase channel for GameFrameX Payment, encapsulating StoreKit behind ApplePaymentManager. Provides a simple API to initialize App Store billing, query product details, buy one-time products and subscriptions, consume consumable purchases, and query purchase history. Includes ApplePayStoreKit bindings with ProductInfo, PurchaseInfo and introductory-price models, ApplePurchaseParams for purchase parameters, and IL2CPP cropping protection. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX Payment Apple — GameFrameX Payment 的 Apple App Store 内购渠道适配包，封装 StoreKit 并由 ApplePaymentManager 提供 API。支持初始化 App Store 计费、查询商品详情、购买一次性商品与订阅、消耗型商品消耗以及查询购买历史。内置含 ProductInfo、PurchaseInfo 与 introductory-price 模型的 ApplePayStoreKit 绑定、ApplePurchaseParams 以及 IL2CPP 裁剪保护。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
